xt20-discovery.dram_basis: Camera MMU first-level table (X-T20 2.11, ff80 read of 0x108000, 2026-10-20): virtual 0-0x3fffffff is normal memory over physical 0. The second bank at 0x80000000 is not declared; no RAM population was measured.
limits: Command-dial edge pacing comes from the emulator, not from camera measurement: on the stock REC X-T20 2.11 graph board the dial poller 0xc8f440 runs every 120000 board ticks (2.5 ms at 48 MHz; 13 entries over 6M executed instructions, deltas 115447..124850, median 119945), and it posts a step after one stable poll (descriptor field +0x14 = 1 at 0xf7a584), so each declared phase edge is held for 240000 ticks, two poll periods.

One firmware step is one full Gray cycle (0xc8fb80 forms 2*A+B from bank 1 bits 2/3 and 4/5; table 0xf7a668 front, 0xf7a64c rear posts 0x25/0x3d for 0->1 and 0x24/0x3c for 1->0). Edges per physical detent are not measured, so the model steps in firmware steps and claims no detent count.
The declared rest phase 2 (A high, B low) is the power-on GPIO bank 1 word 0x1014; one capture held bits 3/5 high instead, so the dial's physical rest position is not established.
